description: This Java source file defines an Android activity and a custom view to demonstrate the use of the Picture class for drawing operations, including recording and rendering custom graphics.

classes.name: Pictures
classes.description: Main activity class for demonstrating graphics with Pictures, extends GraphicsActivity.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner class extending View, handles drawing of Picture and Drawable objects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: drawSomething
methods.description: Static method to draw custom graphics on a Canvas, including a circle and text.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the custom view, creating and recording drawing commands into a Picture, and setting up the Drawable.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's method to perform custom drawing, rendering the Picture and Drawable on the Canvas.
